paths.description: Homepage and primary discovery listing; represents the principal browse task.
Latest-content listing; represents the second listing template and freshness navigation.
Representative media detail and playback surface; highest-risk content and advertising template.
Mobile menu/search journey: open navigation, enter an Arabic query, submit and inspect returned results.

findings.summary: The theme is hard-coded dark rather than following the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The light-preference screenshot and preferences probe show body background rgb(40,40,40), unchanged under prefers-color-scheme: light; no color-scheme media rule was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide light/dark tokens selected with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route changes use abrupt full-page swaps with no View Transition support.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition-name or View Transition API styling across home, latest and detail templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-origin route changes with cross-document View Transitions and a reduced-motion-safe fallback.

findings.summary: Mobile menu and search overlays are custom positioned divs without semantic overlay primitives.
findings.evidence: The implementation probe found zero dialog, popover and details elements while .menu and .search are custom position:absolute overlays.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover for transient menu/search UI with declarative light-dismiss, correct focus handling and fallback styling.

findings.summary: Advertising crowds and competes with the primary video experience.
findings.evidence: The detail screenshot shows multiple ads occupying the full left rail and additional ads immediately below while the player is the core task.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce ad density around playback, reserve predictable slots, and keep the player and controls visually dominant.
findings.guidanceId: avoid intrusive interstitial popup content first

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is viewport-only rather than component-aware.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection shows multiple global min-width media queries but no @container rules; reused cards cannot adapt to their own available space.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/list components containment and use size container queries for local layout changes.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly styled on key controls.
findings.evidence: The platform probe reports outline-style none for links and outline-width 0 for the search input/button; CSS removes input/button outlines.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible treatment and retain native focus unless replaced with an equally visible indicator.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse meta-viewport audit failed because the page declares maximum-scale=1.0 and user-scalable=0.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions; retain width=device-width, initial-scale=1.

findings.summary: Pages have no semantic main landmark.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed landmark-one-main, and the DOM probe found no main/nav/header/aside landmarks across the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in <main> and use semantic header/nav/footer landmarks without changing visual layout.

findings.summary: Parser-blocking CSS and synchronous head scripts delay delivery unnecessarily.
findings.evidence: HAR identifies six parser-inserted stylesheets and four high-priority scripts; DOM confirmation shows jQuery, functions.js, videojs and main.js in HEAD without async/defer/module.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, consolidate imports, and defer non-critical scripts while preserving execution order.

findings.summary: The homepage ships substantial unused JS and CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 42 KiB unused JS (including 93% of videojs) and 16 KiB unused icon CSS (99%).
findings.suggestedFix: Load player code only on detail pages and subset or replace the icon font/CSS.

findings.summary: Most images lack intrinsic dimensions and responsive source declarations.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 71/75 images without width/height and 71 without srcset; four lacked alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio, responsive srcset/sizes, and meaningful alt text for content imagery.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie attributes are materially weak.
findings.evidence: Header inspection found no CSP, HSTS or nosniff; the sole 399-day cookie is not Secure, not HttpOnly and SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Add CSP, HSTS, nosniff and defensive policy headers; make cookies Secure with an appropriate SameSite value and minimise lifetime.

findings.summary: Third-party advertising and tracking dominate the request surface.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 42/60 third-party requests and 216,130 third-party bytes; tracker inventory observed 18 third-party origins, including repeated ad-tech endpoints and identifier-sync URLs.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce vendors, gate non-essential advertising/measurement on informed consent, and proxy or batch only data that is necessary.

findings.summary: The public site has no working sitemap at the conventional location.
findings.evidence: A direct request to /sitemap.xml returned HTTP 404 while robots.txt exposes no alternate Sitemap directive.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish an accurate XML sitemap, reference it from robots.txt and keep canonical/indexing signals consistent.

findings.summary: RTL works visually, but CSS relies heavily on physical directions.
findings.evidence: The document correctly sets lang=ar and dir=rtl, but the implementation probe counted 40 rules using physical left/right margin/padding/position properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace layout-sensitive physical properties with logical inset/margin/padding inline/block properties.

findings.summary: Below-fold images are not natively lazy-loaded or responsively sourced.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 65 below-fold images without loading=lazy and 71 images without srcset, despite a 7,588px homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native lazy loading for below-fold thumbnails and provide srcset/sizes at card breakpoints.

findings.summary: Third-party media and scripts consume a disproportionate share of this simple listing page.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for about 51% of 427,122 transferred bytes and 70% of requests; ad scripts/images include several of the largest resources.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, remove low-value vendors, lazy-load ads below the fold and measure vendor cost against user value.
